delivery_target: Future consumers of unique_table_refsD that already hold cps p' = Some cap' and obj_refs eq but not necessarily cps p = Some cap
new_lemma:
lemma unique_table_refsD_no_left_lookup:
  "\<lbrakk> unique_table_refs cps; cps p' = Some cap';
     obj_refs cap = obj_refs cap'\<rbrakk>
     \<Longrightarrow> table_cap_ref cap = table_cap_ref cap'"
  unfolding unique_table_refs_def
  by blast
rationale: The scanner observed that the head `cps` does not appear in the proof body text beyond the unfolding directive. If unique_table_refs_def is symmetric or blast can derive table_cap_ref cap = table_cap_ref cap' knowing only the right-hand lookup cps p' = Some cap' and the obj_refs equality, the left-hand lookup cps p = Some cap would be droppable. Trial determines whether blast can close the goal without it.
strengthening_claim: (unique_table_refs cps \<and> cps p' = Some cap' \<and> obj_refs cap = obj_refs cap') ==> (unique_table_refs cps \<and> cps p = Some cap \<and> cps p' = Some cap' \<and> obj_refs cap = obj_refs cap')
